subject: Libertarian tech mogul to hit DSA with an eight-figure spending nuke
posts:
Tech mogul Scott Banister launches a $40M spending nuke via Make Liberty Win to counter the DSA.
Evidence: $40M funding, 9 states, grassroots focus
#Aletheia #USPol

A wealthy libertarian donor is deploying a multi-state war chest to halt socialist advances in state legislatures.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Outside billionaire capital floods state races, bypassing local grassroots alignment to engineer partisan outcomes.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.6, -0.5) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Heavy outside capital alters local democratic balance under the guise of grassroots defense.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 2.1, z: 1)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Scott Banister / MLW: COND (-0.6, -0.5) — Deploys massive outside funds into state races.
- Fox News Framing: COND (-0.5, -0.4) — Frames proxy spending as organic defense.
Tech investor Scott Banister committed $40 million to 'Make Liberty Win' to counter Democratic Socialists of America across nine state legislative races.

The Poison:
Bypassing local political accountability through massive, centralized external funding streams.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the WHERE (state-level grassroots policy) with the WHO (billionaire donors steering electoral outcomes).

Social Physics Analysis:
Scott Banister runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using the pretext of stopping socialism to inject massive proxy capital into state races, projecting ideological threats to justify top-down funding.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Outside cash substitutes authentic local organizing.

The Unavoidable Truth: Billionaires shape local state politics just as much as grassroots movements.

The Unavoidable Lie: This $40 million super-PAC deployment represents pure grassroots youth organizing.

Alethekanon:
External capital masquerades as local liberty, proving that cash still dictates ideological battles.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking when local communities feel drowned out by distant fortunes, wishing instead for genuine neighbor-to-neighbor dialogue.

Brothekanon:
Forty million bucks for state races? Wild how a couple of tech bros can just drop a server rack of cash into local politics.

Spirithekanon:
"Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also" Matthew 6:21 PASS
True stewardship invests in human community rather than proxy political warfare.
